plan.notes: Source: The University of Tampa 'Four-Year Degree Plan for Major in Physics, B.S.' (official sample plan PDF, https://smartcatalogiq.com/-/media/institution/ut/cnhs/chemistry-biochemistry-and-physics/fouryear-degree-plan-for-major-in-physics-bs.ashx?la=en), transcribed term by term from the university's current online catalog (Catalog 2026-2027; the plan PDF itself does not print a catalog year). The plan is explicitly a SAMPLE four-year plan. Course codes/titles/credits taken verbatim; prereq arrays are empty (the plan does not publish per-course prerequisites; not invented). PHY 205L and PHY 206L are 0-credit required labs (the plan prints no credit for them and the semester subtotals sum correctly only with 0), marked required_zero. PHY 451 Physics Research is listed as '1-4' credits in both Senior Fall and Senior Spring; the plan's own note ('2 credits of PHY 451 should be taken,' printed under each semester) resolves each to 2 credits, and both semester subtotals (18 and 14) confirm 2 credits per semester — disclosed here per the range rule. 'Physics Elective' slots are the catalog's own category rows (specific qualifying PHY course chosen per catalog). Baccalaureate Experience category slots used verbatim: Social Science (Bacc. Exp), Humanities (Bacc. Exp.), Humanities/Fine Arts (Bacc. Exp.), Biological Science (Bacc. Exp), General Elective (W) [writing-intensive], General Elective (IG) (NW) [international/global, non-western]. Catalog notes carried over: minimum 2.0 GPA overall and in the major; minimum 124 credit hours for the BS in Physics; the math and physical science components of the Baccalaureate Experience are fulfilled by PHY 205 and MAT 260 in the sequence. No TCCNS in Florida; transfer_confidence is empty. allow_repeated_courses is true because PHY 451 Physics Research is genuinely taken in two semesters (2 credits each, Senior Fall and Senior Spring) per the plan.
